title: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
description: Reframes RL as a sequence modeling problem: given past states, actions, and return-to-go (desired cumulative reward), predict the next action. Uses a GPT-2 style transformer. At test time, condition on a high desired return to get high-reward behavior. No Bellman equations, no Q-learning — just supervised learning on trajectories.
authors: Chen, Lu, Rajeswaran, Lee, Grover, Laskin, Abbeel, Srinivas, Mordatch (Berkeley / OpenAI)
